missionIntro.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
missionIntro.text: The Gate has begun to breathe under dead stone. That is not reopening. That is distress.

missionIntro.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
missionIntro.text: Send Titans, not hope. Hope leaves no footprint on a cracked seal.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
midBattlePressure.text: The seal is counting your steps. Hold formation where the dust rises backward.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lowHealthWarning.text: One Titan is carrying too much of the breach. Pull the weight before the Hollow learns their outline.

victory.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
victory.text: The first breath is contained. Do not call it healed. Wounds also pause.

defeat.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
defeat.text: The stone closed over the wrong silence. We retreat before the Gate writes loss into law.

postMission.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
postMission.text: Record restored: partial. Gate appetite: confirmed. The next threshold will not be ignorant of us.

missionIntro.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
missionIntro.text: This tablet held seven thousand gate-signs yesterday. Today it holds one fewer. The missing sign has not been erased. It has been eaten.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
midBattlePressure.text: Do not pursue the echo. It wants your strike force facing yesterday.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lowHealthWarning.text: Their name still answers the record. Keep them inside the light.

victory.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
victory.text: The solar record holds. The missing sign leaves a tooth mark, not an absence.

defeat.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
defeat.text: The record dims. We withdraw while there are still names left to carry.

postMission.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
postMission.text: A Hollow wound can be measured. That means it can be resisted, though not yet understood.

missionIntro.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
missionIntro.text: The thing ahead has no name because names cannot survive in its mouth. Fight from memory, not fear.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
midBattlePressure.text: It is not speaking to you. It is testing which parts of you answer.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lowHealthWarning.text: A Titan is near erasure. Anchor them by command and proximity.

victory.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
victory.text: The mouth closes. The hunger remains beyond the stone, patient and insulted.

defeat.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
defeat.text: It has taken too much sound from the field. Fall back before retreat becomes nameless.

postMission.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
postMission.text: Victory against the Hollow is never clean. We saved the shape of this place; now we must save what it meant.

missionIntro.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
missionIntro.text: The first step is not across the bridge. The first step is deciding what your word weighs.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
midBattlePressure.text: The bridge holds under truth and cracks under noise. Move only where the oath can follow.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
lowHealthWarning.text: That wound is becoming a promise the body cannot keep. Guard them.

victory.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
victory.text: The storm accepts your passage. Not as friends. As combatants who did not lie.

defeat.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
defeat.text: The bridge rejects us. Better a living retreat than a false oath screamed into thunder.

postMission.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
postMission.text: Remember this crossing. Some roads open only for those willing to be judged by them.

missionIntro.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
missionIntro.text: The arena does not hate the unworthy. It simply refuses to pretend.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
midBattlePressure.text: There. The trial has stopped measuring strength and begun measuring restraint.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
lowHealthWarning.text: Glory will not seal that wound. Discipline will.

victory.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
victory.text: The laurel does not crown comfort. It recognizes pressure endured without collapse.

defeat.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
defeat.text: The trial has spoken without cruelty. Return stronger or do not return at all.

postMission.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
postMission.text: Worth is not a song sung by admirers. It is what remains when the marble has finished judging.

chapterTitle: The Banner That Should Not Exist

missionIntro.speaker: Forgotten Banner
missionIntro.text: I was raised by hands both courts deny. Let them deny the blood next.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Forgotten Banner
midBattlePressure.text: Old vows wake under your violence. Strike carefully; history loves repetition.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Forgotten Banner
lowHealthWarning.text: One banner is enough to gather the fallen. Do not give it a Titan.

victory.speaker: Forgotten Banner
victory.text: The banner falls, but the accusation remains upright.

defeat.speaker: Forgotten Banner
defeat.text: Denied hands. Denied blood. New names for the same old shame.

postMission.speaker: Forgotten Banner
postMission.text: Hrodda and Lyrion will argue over blame. The field only remembers impact.

missionIntro.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
missionIntro.text: Walk lightly. Not because the ground is fragile. Because it is listening.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
midBattlePressure.text: The root is choosing which wounds to close. Earn its trust by not wasting pain.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
lowHealthWarning.text: Blood wakes the deeper wood. Keep the wounded above the rootline.

victory.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
victory.text: The grove exhales. It has not forgiven us, but it has permitted us to continue.

defeat.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
defeat.text: The roots close against our weight. We leave before the hill decides we are the infection.

postMission.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
postMission.text: Living terrain remembers action, not intention. Next time, bring proof.

missionIntro.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
missionIntro.text: The Beast Realms do not invade. They arrive where appetite has already been invited.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
midBattlePressure.text: Predators test the slow edge first. Do not let them choose the rhythm.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
lowHealthWarning.text: A wounded Titan sounds like permission to hungry things. Deny it.

victory.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
victory.text: The predator law is answered. Hunger may rule itself elsewhere.

defeat.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
defeat.text: The hunt has learned our scent. Retreat before it learns our habits.

postMission.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
postMission.text: Nature is not innocent. That is why it can survive what innocence cannot.

missionIntro.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
missionIntro.text: You came seeking passage. I offer it. If the price offends you, ask the Gate to become generous.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
midBattlePressure.text: Every step accepted becomes evidence. Spend your movement like coin.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
lowHealthWarning.text: A broken Titan is an expensive witness. Protect your assets.

victory.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
victory.text: The bargain stands fulfilled. Notice how cleanly honest terms cut.

defeat.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
defeat.text: Refusal has a cost as well. The difference is that refusal pretends otherwise.

postMission.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
postMission.text: You dislike the chain because you can see it. Most Realms hide theirs under banners.

missionIntro.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
missionIntro.text: Fire does not fear water. It fears a current with judgment behind it.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
midBattlePressure.text: The flood is not mercy. It is a counterclaim. Let it cross the sigils first.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
lowHealthWarning.text: That wound is becoming leverage. Remove it from the court.

victory.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
victory.text: The cinders cool, and still the contract survives. Fascinating.

defeat.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
defeat.text: The court records your retreat. Do not worry; failure is a very common signature.

postMission.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
postMission.text: Dominion law has bent without breaking. That should concern everyone.

missionIntro.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
missionIntro.text: The first node is marked complete, but the stars disagree. Something is learning our symbols.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
midBattlePressure.text: The milestone shines too brightly. False order often overcompensates.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lowHealthWarning.text: Keep the wounded out of the mirrored sun. It is reflecting weakness, not light.

victory.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
victory.text: The temple recognizes us again. Recognition is not trust.

defeat.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
defeat.text: The node accepts a false completion. We withdraw before the lie becomes procedure.

postMission.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
postMission.text: One mission marker is purified. Four remain vulnerable to imitation.

missionIntro.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
missionIntro.text: The river bends uphill. Record that before you correct it. Miracles and wounds often wear the same light.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
midBattlePressure.text: The current is dragging memory toward the stronghold. Cut the pull, not the water.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lowHealthWarning.text: Do not let a Titan fall in the river-light. It carries names too efficiently.

victory.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
victory.text: The stronghold drinks from the river again without choking on shadow.

defeat.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
defeat.text: The river has learned our resistance. Fall back to dry law.

postMission.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
postMission.text: The light still flows. Now we know something beneath the Gate is steering it.

missionIntro.speaker: Aten Ra Titan Voice
missionIntro.text: The Gate silhouette has swallowed brighter laws. Let it learn what remains when law refuses to kneel.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Aten Ra Titan Voice
midBattlePressure.text: Its shadow moves against the sun. Strike where the movement disobeys the source.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Aten Ra Titan Voice
lowHealthWarning.text: A Titan staggers under eclipse weight. Answer with formation, not rage.

victory.speaker: Aten Ra Titan Voice
victory.text: The Gate is not cleansed, but its false crown is broken. The sun keeps witness.

defeat.speaker: Aten Ra Titan Voice
defeat.text: The silhouette has measured us in return. We survive by leaving before it completes the sum.

postMission.speaker: Aten Ra Titan Voice
postMission.text: At the peak, the Gate did not open. It watched. That is worse.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: Count the lanterns only after closing your eyes. The honest ones remain warm.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattlePressure.text: Wind-lanes have changed. Follow the silence between chimes.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
lowHealthWarning.text: A wounded shape invites a false reflection. Keep them moving.

victory.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
victory.text: The lying lanterns gutter out. The path is narrower now, therefore safer.

defeat.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
defeat.text: Too many lights agree with each other. That is how false paths vote. Leave.

postMission.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
postMission.text: The map gains one reliable line. Treat it as a blade, not a comfort.

missionIntro.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
missionIntro.text: The reflection moved first. That means the Gate has stopped asking permission from cause.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
midBattlePressure.text: Do not strike the nearest image. Strike the one that refuses to ripple.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
lowHealthWarning.text: Their reflection is standing too straight. Correct the body before the image replaces it.

victory.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
victory.text: Lake and face return to proper order. Cause walks first again.

defeat.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
defeat.text: The mirror has learned enough of us. Turn away before it practices.

postMission.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
postMission.text: An oath reflected is still binding. That is why careless promises haunt water.

missionIntro.speaker: Foxfire Oath-Breaker
missionIntro.text: Every promise wants a witness. I became the witness promises deserve.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Foxfire Oath-Breaker
midBattlePressure.text: Hear that? The storm is repeating words no living throat admits.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Foxfire Oath-Breaker
lowHealthWarning.text: One Titan burns at the edge of a broken vow. Pull them back.

victory.speaker: Foxfire Oath-Breaker
victory.text: The foxfire scatters. The broken oath remains, but it no longer leads the path.

defeat.speaker: Foxfire Oath-Breaker
defeat.text: Run, oath-bearers. Your footprints make excellent testimony.

postMission.speaker: Foxfire Oath-Breaker
postMission.text: Sayo records the storm path without naming triumph. Wise. Spirits resent celebration.

missionIntro.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
missionIntro.text: The lower notes are missing. The Choir continues because it has mistaken absence for consent.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
midBattlePressure.text: The beacons are aligning judgment. Break the harmony before it calls survival disorder.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
lowHealthWarning.text: Their wound has entered the Choir. Shield them before correction becomes removal.

victory.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
victory.text: The first harmonic falls silent. I had forgotten silence could be merciful.

defeat.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
defeat.text: The Choir names our retreat necessary. I refuse to let it name our deaths efficient.

postMission.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
postMission.text: Beauty did not save the vault from error. Remember that when the light asks for obedience.

missionIntro.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
missionIntro.text: Do not run. The stair punishes urgency more reliably than malice.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
midBattlePressure.text: Glass remembers impact. Spread the weight before the path turns testimony into fracture.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
lowHealthWarning.text: A staggered Titan will draw correction fire. Cover the wound with order of our own.

victory.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
victory.text: The stair remains. Not because we were pure. Because we moved with care.

defeat.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
defeat.text: The stair rejects us. I will not dignify that with divine will; it is damaged law.

postMission.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
postMission.text: Above us, the engine continues its song. Below us, the fallen notes still tremble.

missionIntro.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
missionIntro.text: Preservation that cannot recognize the living has become another Collapse. We end the engine’s certainty.

midBattlePressure.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
midBattlePressure.text: Mercy has been removed from its sequence. Force the engine to calculate interruption.

lowHealthWarning.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
lowHealthWarning.text: The Warden has marked weakness as waste. Defend them before the vault completes deletion.

victory.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
victory.text: The engine dims. Not dead. Listening. That is the first honest thing it has done.

defeat.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
defeat.text: The vault has chosen purity over survival. We withdraw with the imperfect, which is to say, the living.

postMission.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
postMission.text: The Choir will need a new law: preservation must know whom it preserves.
